name: Ranger Painting

hero.title: No deposit.
hero.lead: Ranger Painting is a locally owned residential painting company in Cedar Park, handling exterior, interior, cabinet, brick and stucco work for homes in Austin and nearby towns. Nathan Wingate walks your project himself and writes the scope you approve.
hero.titleAccent: You pay once you've seen the finished work.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Use the form or call and tell us what you'd like to change.

steps.title: Get a written estimate
steps.text: Ranger walks the project, documents the prep, products and timeline, and hands you a clear scope to decide on, with no pressure and no deposit.

steps.title: Sit back while it gets done
steps.text: You get consistent crews, daily protection and cleanup, and updates throughout, then you pay only after the final walkthrough.

reviews.author: Christine Tom1986
reviews.text: Ranger Painting showed up on a Monday and by Tuesday they had begun. Nathan knew we were going to market the house soon and not only got done in a timely manner but efficient too. His crew were so nice and knowledgeable, carefully maintaining a clean work environment. They said it would be done in four days but with great weather and a great crew 3 days is all it needed. And they are allowing the 5yr home warranty to transfer to the new homeowners!!! Very highly recommended.

reviews.author: Louis Hunt
reviews.text: Ranger Painting did an amazing job on the interior of my home. They used two colors throughout the house, and the cut-in work was absolutely perfect—clean, sharp, and professional. They also worked alongside my roofing company crew, and the coordination was smooth and effortless. The team was on time, respectful, and easy to work with. My home looks fresh and better than ever.

reviews.author: TriTon
reviews.text: I’m very happy with Ranger Painting, the final result truly exceeded my expectations. Nathan, the owner was very attentive, responsive and patiently answering all of my questions. Their price was very reasonable price for the quality of work they delivered. The entire process was smooth and stress-free. I’m extremely pleased with the outcome.

about.title: Twenty years around the trades, then a company of his own
text: Ranger Painting was started by Nathan Wingate, who has spent twenty years around the trades.

Nathan Wingate walks your project himself, writes the scope you'll approve, and stays reachable while the work is underway. A dedicated crew stays on the job start to finish instead of rotating between sites.
Ranger tells you what your home truly needs instead of whatever's easiest to sell, and a project manager walks the finished job with you and fixes punch-list items before you pay.
